notes: BOM, mixed line endings, a quoted multi-line customer, three date forms, quoted thousands separators, six deliberate rejects. A script that skips bad rows silently fails the rejects checks.

spec_map.clean-row-count: do not reject records the rules can fix
spec_map.clean-sorted: every record that is not a reject, sorted by `order_id`
spec_map.clean-multiline-customer-flattened: replace any run of whitespace (including line breaks) with one space and trim
spec_map.rejects-exact: the record number and reason of every reject, in record order
spec_map.rejects-none-silently-dropped: Do not drop or repair rejects silently
